decisions.reason: GA4 remains the standard analytics setup for online shops and this plugin stays close to the firm's core implementation, maintenance, and support work.
The retail system interface plugin still fits the firm's integration capabilities and client needs, but its narrower use case keeps the withdrawal risk comparatively higher.
SEO support for shop relaunches is tightly linked to the firm's relaunch, marketing, and conversion offering and remains a natural service to retain.
SEO workshops complement the firm's advisory and marketing services and can generate client leads, though they are less central than implementation-focused offerings.
